text: Bitcoin has posted modest overnight gains at $81.4k, but Ethereum's 3.4% jump is outpacing it, suggesting alts are attracting incremental capital. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory at 70 with a sharp 13-point weekly climb, while BTC dominance holds firm at 58%, indicating conviction in the majors rather than speculative rotation into smaller caps. The $82B daily volume supports the move but remains moderate, consistent with steady demand rather than euphoric buying.
